entries.description: ToolScout is the Independent Software Discovery & Decision Engine at trytoolscout.org. This read-only MCP helps users decide which software is right for a real job and constraints: evidence-aware shortlists, contextual comparisons, reason-based alternatives, trade-offs, existing-stack fit and recent buyer-relevant changes. Affiliate relationships do not influence decision output.
representativeQueries: What software should I shortlist for this job and these constraints?
Compare HubSpot and Pipedrive for my particular use case
Find alternatives to HubSpot because I dislike the price and complexity
What do I lose if I choose the cheaper option?
Which candidate fits the software I already use?
What changed recently that should affect my shortlist?

entries.description: ToolScout is the independent software discovery and decision engine at trytoolscout.org. This read-only A2A agent turns a software job and constraints into a decision-oriented shortlist and is positioned for software choice rather than generic catalog search.
representativeQueries: Help me decide which CRM fits my team and budget
What software should I shortlist for this workflow?
Recommend software for my job and constraints
